objective: Determine whether tolerance-weighted drift after cancelling the common leading c_i^2 quadratic nonlinear-remainder term carries family-robust safety information beyond v3.0/v3.1 scalar-shape and vector-direction features.

data_roles.N192: sealed independent calibration; forbidden unless one predeclared drift witness survives discovery

quadratic_cancellation.motivation: For F in C^3 and U_i-y=c_i h F_n+O(h^2), D_i=(1/2)c_i^2 h^2 F''[F_n,F_n]+O(h^3), so Z23 and Z34 are O(h^3).

pairwise_tolerance_scale: s_k^{ij}=atol+rtol*max(abs(y_n,k),abs(U_i,k),abs(U_j,k)) on the same physical-component prefix used by existing early-flow telemetry; trailing time-augmentation clock components are excluded.

diagnostics.zeta23: abs(h)*sqrt(mean_k((Z23_k/s_k^{23})^2)); stored as a diagnostic component, not an authority witness
diagnostics.relative_drift: (zeta34-zeta23)/(zeta34+zeta23); PREDECLARED WITNESS 2, with exact 0 when both zetas are zero

feature_domain: atol must be finite and positive; rtol must be finite and nonnegative. If any required physical component or scale is nonfinite, or a scale is nonpositive, the affected zeta/relative drift is null. Finite relative_drift is clamped only to [-1,1] for floating roundoff.
coordinate_scope: The scalar-atol solver contract guarantees permutation invariance and invariance under common state scaling when atol is scaled by the same common factor. Arbitrary independent component rescaling is not claimed.

numerical_work_contract.allowed_diagnostic_work: existing D2/D3/D4 and U2/U3/U4 vector arithmetic, pairwise tolerance scales, WRMS-like reductions, scalar arithmetic only

discovery_robustness_gate.survivor_rule: At most one of the two predeclared authority witnesses may advance. It must satisfy every numeric requirement. Numeric decision thresholds remain forbidden on N96/N256 discovery data.

forbidden: N192 execution before a witness survives discovery
